shadow-black.note: Shadow pigment only, always at an alpha: dark-theme shadow-sm and shadow-md, the ember card and ember button shadows.

display.purpose: The hero name only: the h1, uppercase, one clipped box per word, Rust Name in both themes.

hello.purpose: The greeting on the hero glass card, in white.

hello-compact.purpose: The hero greeting at 720px and below.

display-title.purpose: Centred uppercase titles that open Experience and Tools; ink on the sheet, white on ember.

headline.purpose: Section titles for Work, About and Contact.

title.purpose: Project names; experience card titles use 600 at body size.

lede.purpose: The contact intro line, ink-2 (white at 72% on ember), max 52ch.

quote.purpose: The description on the large experience cards, in ink.

quote-small.purpose: The description on the education cards.

body.purpose: Page default; prose in ink-2, max 62ch.

body-small.purpose: Project summaries, the experience card organisation line, and the hero card intro.

label-caps.purpose: Tool names on tool cards, uppercase.

meta.purpose: Project kind, notes, footer, hero card status line; tool areas at 13px.

mono.purpose: Dates on experience cards, tabular numerals.

mono-tag.purpose: Stack tags and tool-card index numerals at 12px; frame-bar URLs at 11px.

dark.imageFilter: brightness(0.86) on project screenshots and the about photo

fixed.note: The hero stage and the nav floating over it keep light values in both themes; the hero photo is never dimmed.

ember.note: The ember ground, its white text, white focus ring and selection, and the white experience cards on it are identical in both themes.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Rest: seats buttons and the email field on the ground.

shadows.name: primary-sheen
shadows.purpose: Top-edge highlight on the primary button, stacked with shadow-sm.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Hero glass card at rest, over the photo.

shadows.name: sheet-edge
shadows.purpose: Top edge of the page sheet as it slides over the pinned hero.

shadows.name: ember-card
shadows.purpose: White experience cards at rest on the ember ground.

shadows.name: ember-button-rest
shadows.purpose: The inverted primary button on ember, in place of shadow-sm.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve; every transition and animation.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Buttons, links, icon buttons, nav links, copy button.

motion.name: duration-card
motion.purpose: Project card border, shadow and 2px rise; tool card fill and 2px rise.

motion.name: duration-tool-mark
motion.purpose: Tool brand mark scales to 1.08 on card hover.

motion.name: duration-nav-border
motion.purpose: Nav hairline appearing after 8px of scroll.

motion.name: duration-copy-pop
motion.purpose: Copied check icon pops from scale 0.4.

motion.name: duration-image-zoom
motion.purpose: Screenshot scale to 1.03 on card hover.

motion.name: hero-settle
motion.purpose: Hero photo settles once on load; reduced-motion gated.

motion.name: hero-word-up
motion.value: 1100ms; translateY(105%) to rest inside each word's clip; stagger 110ms, base delay 250ms
motion.purpose: Hero name words rise once on load; reduced-motion gated.

motion.name: hero-card-rise
motion.value: 900ms, 650ms delay; translateY(10px) + blur(6px) + opacity 0 to rest
motion.purpose: Hero card follows the name; reduced-motion gated.

motion.name: status-ping
motion.value: 2.4s infinite, 1.8s delay; ring scale 0.6 to 1.5, opacity 0.7 to 0

breakpoints.name: hero-card-drop
breakpoints.purpose: Hero card drops above the name, widens to 460px, long intro sentence hides. Education cards go two columns; tool grid three.

breakpoints.name: work-tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Work cards one per row, frame at 46% beside the text.

breakpoints.name: nav-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Nav links and CV hide; menu button and mobile panel.

breakpoints.name: hero-recrop
breakpoints.purpose: Hero photo re-crops to 104% height at -5% top; card padding 20px; greeting 1.5rem. Work and education cards stack to one column.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Work single column; section heads stack; tool grid two columns (10px gap), 168px cards with 36px marks; the Also row stacks.

breakpoints.name: contact-full
breakpoints.purpose: Email field and contact button go full width.

breakpoints.name: hero-short-landscape
breakpoints.purpose: Hero grows past 100svh instead of crushing the card.

browserSurface.selection: background var(--selection); color var(--ink). On ember: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25) behind #ffffff
browserSurface.focusRing: outline 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset 3px; border-radius 6px (all :focus-visible); outline-color #ffffff on the ember ground
browserSurface.scrollbar: scrollbar-width thin; scrollbar-color var(--line-strong) transparent; WebKit 10px, thumb var(--line-strong) with 3px var(--bg) border, radius 999px
browserSurface.skipLink: ink chip, 8px radius, 10px 14px padding, drops from -48px to 12px on focus

layout.heroStage: position sticky, top 0, height 100svh, min-height 560px, margin-top -64px (under the nav)
layout.heroName: full width, bottom clamp(6px, 1.4vw, 22px), word gap 0.22em
layout.sheet: position relative, z-index 1, background var(--bg); wraps Work to Contact, and the footer
layout.emberSections: Experience and Contact; full-bleed ember ground, grain layer at z-index -1; no hairline above the section or the next one
layout.experienceGrid: work: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) gap 16px; education: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) gap 16px, 16px below (2 columns at 1000px, 1 at 720px)
layout.toolGrid: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) gap 12px (3 at 1000px; 2 with 10px gap at 640px); Also row 32px below
layout.contact: content max-width 760px on the ember ground

materials.name: nav-glass
materials.purpose: Sticky nav once the sheet is under it.

materials.name: ink-glass
materials.value: background rgb(17 24 39 / 0.72); border 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%)

materials.name: film-grain
materials.value: fractalNoise SVG tile (baseFrequency 0.9, 3 octaves, desaturated), 180px, mix-blend-mode overlay; opacity 0.22 on the hero, 0.25 on the ember ground
materials.purpose: Texture over the hero photo and ground, and over the ember ground. Nowhere else.

materials.name: hero-edge-mask
materials.purpose: Feathers the portrait's sides into the matched ground.

materials.name: ember-ground
materials.value: radial-gradient(70% 60% at 80% 105%, rgb(178 54 20 / 0.9), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(55% 55% at 6% -5%, rgb(132 43 16 / 0.8), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(165deg, #2a0a05 0%, #160604 55%, #0d0403 100%); color #ffffff; color-scheme dark
materials.purpose: Experience and Contact, both themes; with film grain at 0.25.

narrative.overview:
This is the developer portfolio everyone recognises, built the way a good product team builds a marketing page. White ground, near-black ink, a single blue that does every action job, hairline grey borders and 12px corners. Nothing in the system is novel on purpose; the craft is in the precision of what is familiar: optical letter-spacing that tightens as type grows, a three-step ink hierarchy, 1px dividers carrying all the structure, and quiet state transitions on one shared easing curve.

The page opens on one authored stage. A full-viewport portrait stands on its own light studio ground, sampled from the photo's backdrop so the picture and the page are one surface; the name is set across the bottom in giant uppercase, and a dark glass card carries the greeting, the two actions and the availability line. The stage is pinned; everything after it is a white sheet that slides up over it with a soft upward shadow, and the nav floats transparent over the photo until the sheet reaches it.

Density on the sheet is calm and readable. A single 1120px column with a fluid gutter holds every section; sections breathe on a fluid 64 to 112px rhythm and are separated by a hairline, not by colour blocks. Work comes first on the sheet, as screenshots seated in thin browser frames, because the screenshots are the evidence.

The one colour block is the ember ground: a deep rust-to-black glow, built from the hero name's rust and grained like the hero photo, that carries Experience and Contact as the sheet's two dark moments. Experience sets white testimonial-style cards on it; Contact turns its controls white. Experience and Tools open with a centred uppercase display title that echoes the name at section scale.

A dark theme mirrors the light one token for token on the sheet. It follows the operating system by default and can be pinned with a toggle; the accent lightens for text and the photos dim slightly so nothing glares on the dark ground. The hero stage stays light, and the ember ground and its white cards stay as they are, in both themes.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink #111827 text, one blue for actions and links.
A pinned, full-viewport photo stage on a light ground matched to the photo, with the name as the display type; the rest of the page slides over it as a sheet.
Structure from 1px hairlines; surfaces on the light ground are flat at rest.
A fixed ember ground (rust glows over near-black, with grain) for Experience and Contact, where actions turn white and cards stay white.
Two uppercase display steps: the hero name, and the centred display titles that open Experience and Tools.
Geist for everything readable; Geist Mono only for data (dates, stack tags, URLs in frame bars, tool-card index numerals).
Corners in a tight family: 6, 8, 9, 10 and 12px, 16px for the hero glass card, plus full circles for dots.
One easing curve (expo-out) for all motion; 180ms for state changes, one authored hero entrance (photo settles, name rises, card follows).
Full light and dark parity on the sheet, driven by the same token names; the hero stage is a fixed light island and the ember ground a fixed dark one.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "you can act here": the primary button, text links, the focus ring, the caret, the confirmed copy state. There is no decorative blue; on the hero card, emphasis is white weight, not blue, and the only blue on the stage is the Hire me button. The name carries the stage's colour in Rust Name instead. On the ember ground there is no blue at all: the primary button inverts to a white fill with ink text (Muted Grey on hover), text links and the focus ring turn white, and the copied state is a stronger white wash, because blue on rust-black would read as a second accent.

rules.name: The Ink Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy on the sheet is three inks (ink, ink-2, ink-3), never opacity or a fourth grey. The two dark surfaces carry their own two-step ladder: white and white at 70% on the hero glass card, white and white at 72% on the ember ground. The white experience cards on ember use the light ladder's ink and ink-3.

rules.name: The Token Parity Rule
rules.body: Every colour on the sheet exists in light and dark under the same name; components reference tokens, never raw hex, so the theme flips with no per-component code. The hero stage and the ember ground are the deliberate exceptions: the stage's ground, ink and glass are scoped light values (the nav pins to them while over the stage), and the ember ground and the white cards on it are scoped fixed values, so neither world inverts.

rules.name: The Matched Ground Rule
rules.body: Every gradient ground is matched to something already on the page. The hero ground is sampled from the photo's own backdrop and the portrait's sides are masked into it; the ember ground is built from the name's rust. A new hero photo means re-sampling the hero ground, and a new name colour means re-deriving the ember glows, never picking a brand colour.

rules.name: The Tightening Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.04em display and display title, -0.03em headline and hello, -0.015em quote, -0.012em title, -0.01em for emphasized body lines, 0 for mono; only small uppercase labels open up, to +0.02em.

rules.name: The One Name Rule
rules.body: The name is the only type at display size: Geist 650, uppercase, 20.2vw, edge to edge, once, on the hero stage. The display title is its echo, not its rival: Geist 700, uppercase, centred, capped at 88px, and only to open a showcase section (Experience, Tools). Every other section title stays at headline in sentence case, and nothing else is uppercase above label size.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for dates, stack tags, the URL in a browser frame and the index numerals on tool cards. Never for headings, labels or prose.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards on the light ground sit flat; lift is a hover response, never a resting state. Project cards lift with shadow-md plus a 2px rise; tool cards lift by tone, their fill darkening to Hairline as they rise 2px, with no shadow. Two things float at rest because they sit on a picture, not on a hairline: the hero glass card over the photo, and the white experience cards over the ember glow.

rules.name: The Two Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass is reserved for the two things that float: the sticky nav (nav-bg under `saturate(180%) blur(14px)`; transparent with no blur while over the stage, opaque when the mobile menu opens) and the hero card (Ink Glass under `blur(20px) saturate(140%)`). There is no third glass surface; the translucent email field on ember is a tint with no blur, not glass.

dos: Do reference colour tokens by name so light and dark stay in parity; add any new colour to both theme blocks.
Do keep the hero stage light in both themes, its ground re-sampled from the photo backdrop and the name in Rust Name.
Do keep Action Blue as a fill for the primary button only, and Link Blue for text links.
